## Core Technical Competencies
- **Frontend & Modern SSR**: React 19, Next.js 15, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, GSAP (GreenSock) 60FPS fluid motion, WCAG accessible semantics, zero CLS design.
- **Backend & Core Runtimes**: Zero-dependency Native Node.js core microservices (`http`, `crypto`, `fs`), Vercel Edge functions, idempotent webhook processing, real-time Kitchen Display Systems (KDS).
- **Data & In-Memory Caching**: Upstash Redis REST KV engine (<10ms global edge latency), Redis Sorted Sets, PostgreSQL relational databases, connection pooling.
- **Security & Cryptography**: HMAC-SHA256 request authentication, anti-replay tokens, replay-proof payment consumers, strict adherence to India's Digital Personal Data Protection Act (DPDP Act 2023).
- **Web Performance**: Perfect Core Web Vitals (sub-second LCP, 0 CLS, minimal INP), asset compression, pre-rendered semantic HTML.
